title: Digital Fly Lab catalogue record (published 2026-09-28; optional fields added in runs 2, 4, 7 and 9)
description: One record per catalogued project. Dates are ISO 8601. 'last_commit' and 'last_release' describe upstream activity; 'last_verified' and 'grade_date' describe our own checks. Values quoted from upstream are in 'claim'; everything else is our own wording.

id.description: Stable lowercase slug. Never reused for another project.

summary.description: One or two sentences in our own words.

claim.description: Short quote of the project's own headline claim, with its URL. A claim, not a finding.

dataset.description: FlyWire FAFB | MaleCNS | BANC | MANC | hemibrain | FANC | larval L1 | several (...) | none | unknown

evidence_grade.description: How well the project's own claim of fly-brain-driven behaviour is supported (not quality or popularity). A: connectome + neural dynamics compared with real-fly data or a proper control (negative results included). B: named connectome release simulated and driving the behaviour, with hand-made input/output mapping, no control. C: subset/stand-in/decorative network, or connectome only triggers scripted programs. D: ordinary game logic, RL without connectome constraints, or LLM; neurons cosmetic. U: mechanism could not be inspected. n/a: infrastructure (datasets, tools, bodies, simulators).

grade_basis.description: What we inspected (file:line, URL), each with a reliability label [direct] / [fetch-summary] / [search-summary].

measured_result.description: Numbers reported from a control or benchmark, with location. Measured by the author unless stated.

try_status.description: e.g. 'page responds (HTTP 200, checked 2026-09-28), not played by us'.

code_licence.description: SPDX id from the LICENSE file, or 'none found', 'custom: ...', 'n/a (no code repository)'.

last_commit.description: Upstream: last commit on the default branch (committer date).

created_at.description: Upstream repository creation date. NOT an update date.

last_verified.description: Our last HTTP check of this record's links.

grade_note.description: Publisher note for borderline or reviewed grades. The grade itself is unchanged.

try_note.description: Access note for the try link, for example a required sign-in.

api_fields_reused.description: GitHub API fields (stars, created_at, pushed_at) copied from an earlier check instead of re-queried, because the API quota was low. Added 2026-09-28 (run 2).

api_fields_reused_from.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the earlier check that api_fields_reused come from. Added 2026-09-28 (run 2).

archived_source.description: Where the archived status was read, for example the GitHub repository page. Added 2026-09-28 (run 2).

added_in_run.description: Research run that first added this record to the catalogue (absent for records from the first release). Added 2026-09-28 (run 2).

project_page.description: Route of our substantive project page for this entry, when one exists. Added 2026-09-28 (run 2).

platform_note.description: Full wording behind platform when it needs more detail than the enumerated values (for example "macOS (Apple silicon)"). Added 2026-09-28 (run 2).

gpu_note.description: Full wording behind gpu (for example "required (NVIDIA CUDA for training)"). Added 2026-09-28 (run 2).

peer_review_note.description: Full wording behind peer_review (for example "none (blog post)"). Added 2026-09-28 (run 2).

controls.description: Added in run 4 (2026-09-30), optional. Whether the project tests its result against a wiring null (shuffled, rewired or random wiring), only against a no-brain or no-graph baseline, or has no control. Studies are in assets/data/controls.json.

wiring_effect.description: Added in run 4 (2026-09-30), optional. Copied from the study in controls.json; 'not-tested' whenever controls is not 'wiring-null'.

browser_check.description: Added 2026-10-03 (run 7), optional: result of our pre-registered headless-browser check (headless Chromium 154, Linux, no GPU; checks of 3 and 6 Oct 2026). Shows whether the page loads, downloads its brain data and keeps computing; not a play test. source names the published result file.

trained_class.description: Added 2026-10-06, optional. 'Is it AI?': which part of the project, if any, is trained, learned or tuned by search in its main (default) path. none = no trained part; readout-or-decoder = a trained readout, decoder or fitted readout on a frozen connectome network; front-end = a pretrained sensory front end (for example a vision model) in front of the wiring; whole-network-or-per-synapse = synapse weights or per-cell parameters inside the network are trained; policy-or-llm = a trained policy or language model chooses actions outside the wiring; other = learning rules during a run (STDP, dopamine plasticity) or a few parameters optimised by search; not-assessed = not graded (evidence grade U or n/a).

trained_class_note.description: Added 2026-10-06, optional. Plain-text detail for trained_class, for example an optional trained part that the main path does not use.

learning.description: Added in run 15 (2026-10-13), optional. 'Can it learn?': what changes with experience in the project's main path, read at the catalogued commit. 'meaning' is attributed to its source (for example 'The README says ...'); what_is_trained and wiring_control are our classification of the cited lines. A field that could not be read is left out and named in check_note as 'not checked'.

enum: plasticity rule on part of the network
what_is_trained.description: none = nothing changes with experience; readout only = a readout or decoder on a fixed network; plasticity rule on part of the network = a learning rule (for example dopamine-gated) changes some synapses during a run; whole network = gains, weights or per-cell parameters throughout the network are trained (wiring itself may stay fixed); hand mapping = a hand-made mapping is changed by the author, no learning.

wiring_control.description: Whether the project compares its result with shuffled, rewired or random wiring; see control_study.

control_study.description: Ledger study id in controls.json when wiring_control is 'shuffled or rewired'.

meaning.description: One neutral sentence: what changes with experience, attributed to its source.

check_note.description: Our check note: which fields were not checked and why.

owner_move.description: A repository or page move made by the project owner, with date, old and new address and a plain note. Added 2026-10-13 (run 15).
